Visitor privacy

A static public website with no sign-in or feedback submission form.

The rebuilt briefing does not add analytics scripts, advertising trackers or cookies. Its main pages serve fonts locally. The hosting provider may process normal connection and server-log information.

Copy-link buttons use your browser’s clipboard only when you press them. Source links may open other websites, which have their own policies.

The source guides use the same local assets as the briefing. Linked external records have their own privacy policies.
